answer: Operator-Linked Identity Prism: each new identity must cite a unique accountable operator, and operators carry a public failure score. A falcon flag—any confirmed sybil cluster—raises the operator’s score, throttling all its identities’ transaction throughput. Attackers therefore pay per-operator, not per-wallet: spinning up wallets on a fresh operator triggers a reef of collateral deposits and slow onboarding, while reuse collapses the whole cluster at once.
